children: NVIDIA announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $11.9 billion plus up to $1.0 billion in employee equity retention.
Deal terms: approximately $11.9B purchase price payable to Hugging Face stockholders, subject to adjustments.
Employee retention: equity-based retention program of up to about $1.0B for Hugging Face employees joining NVIDIA.
Timing and conditions: transaction expected to close in first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
Commitments & risks: NVIDIA will keep Hugging Face’s platform open; regulatory restrictions on open-source models could affect the platform and expected benefits.
